evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen to 15.0 ppm from 28766.3 ppm at 120 s; subsequent readings remained low.
Temperature 749.4 °C closely tracked the ramp setpoint of 749.6 °C.
Growth-transition temperature overshoot to 761.4 °C accompanied by heater power reduction to 40.2%, consistent with a settling transient.

Temperature settled toward the 750 °C setpoint to 752.5 °C with 42.2% heater power; Ar 100.1 sccm matched 100 sccm setpoint, pressure was stable at 760.4 Torr, oxygen was 3.9 ppm, and status was running.
